responsibility: This definition module declares the timer and event-waiting API that complements the coroutine executive with tick-based scheduling. It defines the exported tick rate constant and opaque EVENT type, and exposes routines to query uptime ticks, sleep the current process, arm/rearm or cancel timer events, and wait on an event until expiry or cancellation, forming the public interface for timed blocking and round-robin scheduling support.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the exported interface for timer services: it declares the opaque EVENT type, tick constant, and public Sleep/ArmEvent/WaitOn/Cancel/ReArmEvent routines, but omits the timer-process creation, event-queue representation, and timeout bookkeeping implemented in TimerHandler.mod.
